description: Ozon Intelligence SR: ozon/shop Search API.

id.description: Store (seller) ID, which is the `sellerId` returned by other SR Ozon tools; negative values are self-operated sellers on the Ozon platform, and positive values are third-party sellers.

memberId.description: Member ID; a member's unique identifier, the data belongs to this member, the maximum number is 1000.

orders.description: Sorting rule, the element is `{field, direction}`; `direction` takes `DESC` or `ASC`. Commonly used fields: `sales`, `price`, `reviewRating`, `upTime`.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of items per page is 20. If exceeded, `errcode 1002` will be returned.
